summary.intent: Drive the Callisto Rust release manager to v1 by working through the local NEXT-WORK plan: opening PRs for fixes (retry, tests, docs, refactors, T06 canonical references), resolving pending owner decisions, and continuing until the plan is done.
summary.outcome: Opened and landed many PRs: SYS-RETRY, W1 test, W0 docs, R5 stack with SYS-NAPI, R3 derive split, T06 colon rejection (E316, merged), CI hygiene (#271, green), and E317 (#272, open). Decisions were recorded (lockstep versioning). The pre-mode no-repeat-bump fix with E318 passed local CI and its signed commit was being created, with the PR not yet opened.

repo: Tracking and handoff plans (NEXT-WORK.md) must stay local in .claude/plans/ and be excluded via .git/info/exclude; never commit them or put them in a PR.

Commits must be signed (plain `git commit`, global gpgsign on); never use `-c commit.gpgsign=false` on real repos. Verify with `git log '--format=%G?'`. PRs must be opened ready for review, not as drafts.
`just ci` includes a 90% coverage gate and workflow-contract/zizmor/action-pin checks; always read the `exit=` line in the CI log because the background task wrapper reports exit 0 regardless.
AGENTS.md rules: no spec IDs in code, succinct docs, one changeset per user-visible topic, no hard-wrapped Markdown, no claude.ai links in PRs/commits.

Error codes: every Diagnostic variant needs a code (registry test), and docs/errors.md holds the E-code table and total count (E316 colon form, E317 bare config reference, E318 release-pr in pre mode).
Callisto has four published crates (callisto-model MIT, manifests, graph, cli FSL) plus dev-only callisto-fixtures, all in one fixed group, so versioning is lockstep. Consolidation shipped in #157.

Rerun-after-failed-push fix: a package whose current version is tagged at HEAD now has every operation (registry, tag, GitHub release) observed and stays selected until all are satisfied; a tag on an older commit settles without contacting providers.
The release e2e harness fakes gh/cargo/registry, so fakes can hide bugs; the plan demands proving with the real tool (e.g. real jq and binary in the SYS-NAPI test).

code.finding: PackageId::colon_form_canonical detects `eco:name` and returns the `eco/name` slash form; PackageId::parse still reads colon internally by design.
A catch-all Err(_) mapped every group-member resolution failure to MissingGroupMember, hiding E103 and E316; now only UnknownPackage maps to it.
Generated workflow template must avoid bash `mapfile` (macOS bash 3.2 lacks it); napi roster is now derived per intent package via `callisto matrix` and handed to placement.

workflow: Write the failing black-box reproduction first, then fix; for pure refactors, add characterization/snapshot tests first and prove they catch a mutation before moving code.
Scripted bulk edits (python replace scripts) can corrupt unrelated text (double prefixes, altered comments); review `git diff --stat` and staged files before committing.
The sandbox rejects inline env, heredocs and compound commands; write scripts/messages to files in the job tmp dir and run them, and edit only inside the current worktree.
Use zsh-safe syntax (`${var}:`, quoted `%G?`, `${=var}`); bash 3.2 has no `declare -A`.
Use independent-agent review for risky PRs (done for #202), and stack dependent PRs with native `gh stack`.

friction: Plan file was initially put in PR #201 and had to be closed; the user objected that tracking files belong local only.
Commits were created unsigned via `gpgsign=false`, requiring re-signing and force-pushing 17 commits.
Sandbox/classifier blocks on inline scripts, heredocs and out-of-worktree edits forced repeated workarounds and worktree switching.
Background task notifications reported exit 0 while CI had actually failed (fmt-check, earlier exit=101).
PR #267 conflicted with #266 and needed a rebase.
The scripted fixture conversion for E317 double-prefixed and altered unrelated comments, needing cleanup.
Merged remote branches could not be safely identified because of squash merges, so branch deletion was skipped.
open_items: Open the PR for the pre-mode no-repeat-bump / E318 fix once the signed commit completes, and watch hosted CI on #272.
T06 PR 4: remove now-unreachable bare-rule code (second pass in resolve_package_config, promoted_siblings, bare-rule diagnostic, from_groups, resolve_unique, resolve_human) after #272 merges.
T06 PR 5: canonical ids in reports with schemaVersion 2, text tables canonical.

Remaining queued tasks: stale-range rewrite on pre graduation (A4), dist-tag derivation and snapshot refusal, concurrency group in generated workflow, redacted output tail, status --check for pending-without-changeset, Python dev table warning.
Branch cleanup: stale branches (docs/next-work-plan, docs/spec-rewrite, fix/native-resolution, ~35 local) awaiting per-branch user approval; docs/crate-consolidation-plan to delete.
W1 real-service credential check needs a decision on where it runs; W11 verification needs credentials.
W0 docs PR #204 still lists SYS-RETRY/T08-RETRY and needs a follow-up edit after #202.
Post-1.0: OIDC trusted publishing, semver-checks scoped to promised surfaces, possibly merging callisto-manifests into callisto-graph.
A2 (local route releases HEAD) needs a design spike; other owner decisions in V1-REVIEW section D remain tracked in the local proposals file.
